title: From sodium butanoate to 1-phenylphthalazine: Kolbe electrolysis, Friedel-Crafts acylation, Rosenmund reduction and the tests on Q, R, S and T
summary: A four-carbon salt goes in and a nitrogen heterocycle comes out. Press start and the lab does the rest: Kolbe's electrolysis couples two propyl radicals to n-hexane, V2O5 at 500 C closes it into benzene, Friedel-Crafts with phthalic anhydride gives 2-benzoylbenzoic acid, PCl5 and a poisoned Rosenmund catalyst give 2-benzoylbenzaldehyde, and hydrazine closes 1-phenylphthalazine. Every structure is drawn from its bonds, and each option is tested - Cl2/UV on Q, cyclisation plus Clemmensen on R, Tollens on S, a ring-atom audit on T - before the answer is revealed. No prediction stage - input, run, watch, result.
subject: Chemistry
topic: Reaction sequence - Kolbe electrolysis, Friedel-Crafts acylation, Rosenmund reduction, Tollens test and hydrazine ring closure
subtopics: Aromatisation of n-hexane over V2O5 (or Cr2O3/Mo2O3) at high temperature
Free-radical addition of Cl2 to benzene under UV - benzene hexachloride, gammaxane
Friedel-Crafts acylation with a cyclic anhydride
Acid-catalysed intramolecular acylation to anthraquinone and Clemmensen reduction
Acid chlorides from PCl5 and the Rosenmund reduction
Condensation of 1,4-dicarbonyls with hydrazine - phthalazines, heterocycles
concepts: Kolbe's electrolysis: 2 CH3CH2CH2COO- -> CH3(CH2)4CH3 + 2CO2 + 2e- (two propyl radicals couple)
n-Hexane over V2O5 at 500 C and 10-20 atm cyclises and loses 4 H2: Q = benzene
Benzene + excess Cl2 under UV adds three Cl2 to give C6H6Cl6 (BHC); its gamma-isomer is gammaxane (lindane): (B) true
Friedel-Crafts acylation with phthalic anhydride/AlCl3 gives R = 2-benzoylbenzoic acid
Acid cyclisation of R gives anthraquinone; Clemmensen (Zn-Hg/HCl) reduces both C=O to CH2, giving 9,10-dihydroanthracene C14H12, not 9,10-dihydroxyanthracene C14H10O2: (D) false
PCl5 then H2 over poisoned Pd/BaSO4 (Rosenmund) stops at the aldehyde: S = 2-benzoylbenzaldehyde, which gives a silver mirror with Tollens' reagent: (A) true
The aldehyde and ketone of S are 1,4-related; hydrazine condenses with both (-2H2O) to give 1-phenylphthalazine, a heterocycle with N-N in the ring: (C) true
answerValue: Q = benzene, R = 2-benzoylbenzoic acid, S = 2-benzoylbenzaldehyde, T = 1-phenylphthalazine

derivedQuantities.custom_PdC: S = 2-benzoylbenzyl alcohol, T = hydrazone - only (B) holds

methods: Solved independently before any key was consulted: Q benzene, R 2-benzoylbenzoic acid, S 2-benzoylbenzaldehyde, T 1-phenylphthalazine; (A), (B), (C)
Element and charge balance of every step: Kolbe, aromatisation, chlorination, Friedel-Crafts, PCl5, Rosenmund, Tollens, hydrazine condensation, cyclisation and Clemmensen

RDKit reaction templates applied to the structures generate the products (Kolbe coupling, Friedel-Crafts opening of the anhydride, intramolecular acylation, Clemmensen C=O -> CH2, PCl5, Rosenmund) and match the named compounds by canonical SMILES
Functional-group SMARTS: only S has an aldehyde C-H; T has two ring N; the Clemmensen product C14H12 has no oxygen, unlike 9,10-dihydroxyanthracene C14H10O2
Gammaxane (lindane) has the same constitution as the C6H6Cl6 addition product
Custom-condition controls: sodium propanoate gives n-butane (no benzene); unpoisoned Pd/C over-reduces S to the alcohol (Tollens negative, no ring closure)
Independent script tests/verify_p1q08.py: 24 of 24 checks pass

interactivity: Mission brief with the printed scheme drawn from bond lists and Q = ?, R = ?, S = ?, T = ? tiles that fill in as the lab makes them
Step 1: an electrolysis cell - CO2 bubbling at the anode, two propyl radicals coupling, n-hexane drawn from its bonds
Step 2: a V2O5 tube furnace heating to 500 C at 10-20 atm, hexane folding into benzene and losing 4 H2
Test (B): a UV lamp over benzene and excess Cl2, six Cl atoms adding - C6H6Cl6, gamma-isomer gammaxane
Step 3: phthalic anhydride opening to an acylium ion and acylating benzene - R
Test (D): R closing to anthraquinone, Clemmensen turning both C=O into CH2, and the claimed 9,10-dihydroxyanthracene shown beside it with its different formula
Step 4: PCl5 then a Rosenmund reduction ladder - the poisoned catalyst stops at the aldehyde
Test (A): a test tube warming in a water bath with Tollens' reagent until a silver mirror plates the glass
Step 5: hydrazine condensing with both carbonyls, water leaving, a new N,N ring highlighted - T
